options.description: Enter lockup state when ICMP rate exceeds lockup rate limit (Maximum rate limit. If exceeds this limit, drop all ICMP packet for a time period)

options.description: Lockup period (second)

options.description: ICMPv6 rate limit (Normal rate limit. If exceeds this limit, drop the ICMP packet that goes over the limit)

options.description: Virtual server template name

options.description: State of the object to be created.

options.description: Send gratuitous ARP for every IP in the subnet virtual server

options.description: The time tcp stack will wait before allowing new fast-open requests after security condition, default 600 seconds (number)

options.name: tcp_stack_tfo_cookie_time_limit
options.displayName: Tcp Stack Tfo Cookie Time Limit
options.description: The time limit (in seconds) that a layer 7 tcp fast-open cookie is valid, default is 60 seconds (number)
